title: MCP server (Model Context Protocol)
asked: Backfilled from the build queue (done step) (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: The console API as MCP tools for Claude: plan search/edit, build queue (next, reorder, reprocess, complete), catalog status, libraries, templates, app init/validate, terminal. Remote at console.amberxai.com/mcp (streamable HTTP, Bearer AXF_TOKEN) or local over stdio via .mcp.json.
